ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: Reprize uses the camera to record your clips.
ios.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Reprize records the sound of your clips.
ios.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Reprize listens for you to say "save" or "record" so you can save a clip without touching your phone.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Reprize saves the clips you export to your photo library.
ios.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Reprize uses your local network to show the camera image on the phone you use as a remote.
ios.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: Reprize uses Bluetooth to talk to the phone you use as a remote and to show whether your selfie remote is connected.
